verdict.rationale: Opting out of a SaaS vendor's own usage tracking is a fair question for an observability platform like Honeycomb, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only the customer telemetry Honeycomb ingests (OpenTelemetry traces, logs, metrics) and EU/North America region selection. Neither is a control for opting out of Honeycomb's own telemetry or usage tracking, so there is no documented support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
